protocol: Within-statement leave-one-actor-out: 92 train, 4 test. Train-only StandardScaler, C=1 lbfgs max_iter=5000, happy=1; all conditions independently fitted with identical splits.
primary: Block6 mean actor x statement fold AUC; direct paired contrasts no_attn-clean and no_attn-no_mlp. Equal actor and statement weights; repetitions pooled within each held-out actor/statement fold.
secondary: Final normalized answer-state readability; pooled OOF AUC, accuracy, and no_mlp-clean descriptive. No native LM-head performance claim.
uncertainty: Shared paired actor-cluster percentile 95% bootstrap across conditions/endpoints/statements; all statements retained per actor. Fixed fitted probes, no bootstrap refits; unadjusted intervals conditional on the fixed selected statements (statements are not resampled).
scope: Second-checkpoint replication on frozen existing datasets, fixed zero-based blocks1–6; no layer or condition reselection. This is not a cross-architecture claim. Within-statement probes do not establish classifier transfer to unseen statements.
